name: Claude limit
author: ismoil
description: Claude usage limits in the bar, readable for low vision: the 5-hour window and the week with plain-language verdicts, a pace meter, forecast and a weekly-share ceiling. English and Russian, large-text mode, WCAG AA contrast.

barWidget.description: 5-hour limit in the bar; popup with the week and model limits, pace and forecast

schema.label: Language
schema.description: auto follows the system locale (Russian or English).

schema.label: Text size
schema.description: Scales the popup text and the bar text. Text is never smaller than 13 px.

schema.label: Active hours: from (0-23)
schema.description: The week's pace is counted over the hours you actually use Claude.

schema.label: Animations
schema.description: Turn off to stop the meters from sliding.

schema.label: Renew the Claude login when it expires
schema.description: Off by default. When on, an expired token is renewed the way Claude Code does it and written back to ~/.claude/.credentials.json. When off, the widget waits until you run claude.
